title: Native CLM v0 M3W-0 — Root Write-Drift Counterfactual Restoration
scientific_question: Using only the already-published M3L-2 final checkpoints, how much of residual A forgetting is causally attributable to final operator-state drift in the original eight roots versus final operator-state drift in descendants, when routing/address state is held fixed?

counterfactuals.root_restore: restore only original Cells 0..7 operator weights to exact M1 weights; keep descendants, final routing, address states, affine gates and all non-operator state unchanged
counterfactuals.descendant_root_restore: keep original root operators final; restore every descendant operator to the exact M1 operator of its root ancestor; keep final routing/address state unchanged
counterfactuals.all_lineage_restore: restore every Cell operator to the exact M1 operator of its root ancestor; keep final routing/address state unchanged

factorial_mapping.00: all_lineage_restore: root operator drift off, descendant operator-state drift off
factorial_mapping.10: descendant_root_restore: root operator drift on, descendant operator-state drift off
factorial_mapping.01: root_restore: root operator drift off, descendant operator-state drift on
factorial_mapping.11: final: root operator drift on, descendant operator-state drift on

attribution.new_domain_gain_retention_under_root_res: for each D in B,C,D: (L_M1_D - L_root_restore_D) / (L_M1_D - L_final_D)
attribution.interpretation_boundary: The factors attribute causal effects of final operator-state deviations from an M1-root baseline. A descendant final operator may include drift inherited from its parent at birth because exact child birth tensors were not persisted. Therefore descendant Shapley is not a count or isolation of post-birth child write events, and root Shapley is not a complete historical attribution of every update that originated while an ancestor was a root.

classification_rule: INCONCLUSIVE_IDENTITY if any seed fails all-lineage M1 reconstruction or recovers <95% of A excess loss. Otherwise ROOT_WRITE_DOMINANT_* if every seed has A_root_fraction >=0.60, split by whether every B/C/D gain-retention ratio under root_restore is >=0.70. DESCENDANT_WRITE_DOMINANT if every seed has descendant Shapley fraction >=0.60. Otherwise DISTRIBUTED_WRITE_DRIFT. Classification names use write-drift shorthand but are interpreted only as final operator-state attribution under the registered M1-root baseline.
explicit_nonclaims: historical per-update or post-birth write-event attribution
proof that copy-on-write will solve continual learning
next_if_root_write_dominant: register a new formal experiment whose only new integration variable is write-ownership separation / copy-on-write immutable committed parents
next_if_not_root_write_dominant: freeze M3W-0 result and diagnose descendant/operator-state interaction before adding a write controller
